function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Below is a quick‑look guide to the **next few major festivals happening in the United States** (sorted by start date).  All dates are for 2024 unless otherwise noted.  Check each festival’s official website for the most up‑to‑date information, ticket sales, and any COVID‑related changes.

| # | Festival | Dates (2024) | Location | Type | Official Site |
|---|----------|--------------|----------|------|---------------|
| 1 | **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | Apr 12‑14 | Indio, CA | Music & Arts | https://www.coachella.com |
| 2 | **Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC) Las Vegas** | May 4‑6 | Las Vegas, NV | Electronic Dance Music | https://edc.com |
| 3 | **Lollapalooza Chicago** | Jun 1‑3 | Chicago, IL | Music (Rock/Pop/Indie) | https://www.lollapalooza.com |
| 4 | **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | Jun 15‑18 | New Orleans, LA | Jazz & Cultural | https://www.nojazzfest.com |
| 5 | **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | Jun 20‑23 | Manchester, TN | Music & Arts | https://www.bonnaroo.com |
| 6 | **Taste of Chicago** | Jun 1‑2 | Chicago, IL | Food & Culture | https://www.tasteofchicago.com |
| 7 | **Summerfest** | Jun 27‑29 | Milwaukee, WI | Music & Arts | https://www.summerfest.com |
| 8 | **Newport Folk Festival** | Jul 5‑7 | Newport, RI | Folk Music | https://www.newportfolk.org |
| 9 | **Comic-Con International** | Jul 20‑23 | San Diego, CA | Pop Culture & Comics | https://www.comic-con.org |
|10 | **SXSW (South by Southwest)** | Mar 8‑17 | Austin, TX | Music, Film & Interactive | https://www.sxsw.com |
|11 | **Austin City Limits Music Festival** | Oct 12‑14 | Austin, TX | Music (Various Genres) | https://www.aclfestival.com |
|12 | **Burning Man** | Aug 28‑Sep 5 | Black Rock City, NV | Art & Culture | https://burningman.org |

### How to Use This List

1. **Pick a festival that interests you** – whether it’s music, food, art, or pop culture.  
2. **Visit the official site** for ticketing, lineup, accommodation, and travel tips.  
3. **Check the weather** for the festival location (you can use the Open‑Meteo API if you’d like a forecast).  
4. **Plan your trip** – book flights, hotels, and transportation early to lock in the best rates.  

### Quick Weather Check (Optional)

If you’d like a quick weather forecast for a specific festival location, let me know the festival name and I can fetch the latest data using the Open‑Meteo API.  

Enjoy planning your festival adventure!
